answer: Audits are entered in pulse, queued in velvet, and cedar publishes the wait time. A farm of 311 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 21 identities per epoch. A farm of 4348 identities would post 1916 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
